items.title: Your re:Invent 2026 guide to mainframe modernization with AWS Transform
items.summary: Mainframe modernization has entered the agentic era. At AWS re:Invent 2026, customers will show how AWS Transform, the agentic AI service for migration and modernization, makes decades of business logic visible across mainframe, midrange, and distributed systems. Kiro, the AI-powered development environment from AWS, brings agentic coding to forward engineering. Together, they compress a journey […]
